# Blender MCP Pro tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_tool_reference.py. -->

The full MCP profile registers **313 tools** in **25 categories**.
The bridge offers the profiles listed below. Each entry lists the inputs
accepted by the registered tool. The [JSON catalog](tool-schemas.json) includes
input types, defaults, profile membership, and discovery metadata.
The `bridge` marker identifies discovery tools handled locally by the bridge.

In a connected MCP client, call `tools_search` with a name or phrase and
use `tools_describe` for the active tool's schema. `tools_catalog` can
return all active tools or filter by one of the categories below.

## Profiles

Set `BLENDER_MCP_PROFILE` before launching the bridge. The default is
`full`. An unknown name falls back to `core`. Profiles control tool
registration and discovery. The add-on enforces execution permissions.

## Core

| Tool | Purpose | Required arguments | Optional arguments |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clear_scene` | Remove objects from scene (optionally keeping cameras and lights). Returns a dry-run unless confirm=true. | — | `keep_cameras_and_lights`, `confirm` |
| `create_checkpoint` | Save a scene snapshot before risky edits (keeps last 10 snapshots). | — | `name` |
| `delete_object` | Delete an object by name. Returns a dry-run unless confirm=true. | `name` | `confirm` |
| `duplicate_object` | Duplicate an object with its mesh data. | `name` | `new_name`, `location` |
| `get_object_info` | Get detailed world bounding box, metric dimensions, polygon count, and hierarchy for an object. | `name` | — |
| `get_scene_info` | Get comprehensive geometric and spatial info about the current Blender scene. | — | `max_objects` |
| `health_check` | Run read-only context, scene, main-thread, add-on and memory checks. | — | — |
| `list_checkpoints` | List all available scene checkpoints. | — | — |
| `list_objects` | List all objects in the scene, optionally filtered by type ('MESH', 'LIGHT', 'CAMERA'). | — | `type_filter` |
| `project_info` | Report Blender, add-on, scene, data counts, units and render engine. | — | — |
| `rollback_checkpoint` | Roll back the scene to a previously saved checkpoint. Returns a dry-run unless confirm=true. | — | `name`, `confirm` |
| `run_workflow` | Execute a bounded sequence of tool calls in one command. steps: [{"tool": "...", "params": {...}}]. Rejects run_workflow and execute_code. | `steps` | `stop_on_error`, `max_steps` |
| `tools_catalog` | List active tools with category, safety, cost, units and profiles. Optionally include JSON input schemas. | — | `category`, `include_schema` |
| `tools_describe` | Describe one active tool: description, safety, cost, units, profiles and input schema. | `name` | — |
| `tools_search` | Search tool names and descriptions. Use this before guessing a tool name. | `query` | `limit` |
| `transform_object` | Transform location, rotation (deg), scale, or metric dimensions. | `name` | `location`, `rotation_deg`, `scale`, `dimensions`, `apply_scale` |

## Export

| Tool | Purpose | Required arguments | Optional arguments |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `export_scene` | Export with profile godot/unity/unreal/generic-gltf. Validates scale, materials, UVs, armatures, actions, LOD and collision meshes; reimports into the scene and compares dimensions when possible. format defaults to GLB, or FBX for unreal. Paths are confined to BLENDER_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR unless BLENDER_MCP_ALLOW_ANY_PATH=1. | `filepath` | `format`, `profile`, `force`, `verify_reimport` |
| `generate_game_ready_asset` | Normalize, ground, decimate over budget, add convex _colonly hulls and re-audit. Returns export-ready report (no file written). | — | `object_names`, `target_engine`, `generate_collision_hull`, `max_tris` |

## Inspection

| Tool | Purpose | Required arguments | Optional arguments |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `audit_3d_model` | Audit evaluated geometry: dimensions, ground contact, normalized scale, BVH intersections and closed-solid overlap, contact graph, topology, symmetry and optional blueprint dimensions. Returns passed, requirements, failures and the legacy critical_issues/warnings views. passed is computed after every requirement. Use 'strict' to require clean topology and a contact path to the ground for every structural part. Names in suspended are excluded from ground/floating checks. | — | `object_names`, `blueprint_name`, `contact_tolerance`, `suspended`, `ground_tolerance`, `scale_tolerance`, `symmetry_axis`, `symmetry_plane`, `symmetry_tolerance`, `topology_policy`, `check_self_intersections` |
| `ground_model` | Translate target objects rigidly so the lowest point touches Z=0.0. | — | `object_names`, `center_xy` |
| `render_multiview_inspection` | Deterministic inspection render: quad (FRONT/RIGHT/TOP ortho + ISO perspective) or a single mode (front, side, top, iso, silhouette, wireframe, normals, uv_checker). Returns the image plus camera, resolution, background, render_id and audit metadata. include_overlays draws the assembly bounding box and reports dimensions in metadata. | — | `object_names`, `resolution`, `show_wireframe`, `blueprint_name`, `suspended`, `mode`, `include_overlays` |
| `repair_mesh_geometry` | Clean mesh topology, remove duplicate vertices, recalculate outward normals, and apply scales safely. | — | `object_names`, `merge_distance`, `recalc_normals`, `apply_scale`, `shade_smooth` |
